verdict.rationale: Orama ships as a JS/TS (and Rust/Python SDK) library with programmatic insert/search APIs and no UI dependency, meaning it can be embedded and run headlessly in scripts, servers, or automation pipelines (e.g. orama-docs-2, orama-docs-15, orama-docs-21). However, there is no explicit documentation of CI-specific workflows, CLI tooling, or headless automation examples. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, a dedicated CLI for automation, and independent evidence of headless CI usage.
